title: Mud and Lanterns

goal.text: Find sure footing in the squelchy marsh.

steps.label: Get your boots good and muddy

scene_reeds.narration: The Marsh Approach squelches. A boggart with a lantern offers you a pot of thick, warm mud for your boots.

scene_mud.narration: Your boots feel heavy and sure. Whatever comes next, you will not slip.
